tree: How do points and rewards stay accurate?
Points are posted from completed sales and reversed when a sale is refunded. Every change is recorded in the member’s ledger.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Can I set tiers and expiry rules?
Yes. You choose tier thresholds, what members earn per dollar, which rewards are available and when points expire.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Do members need to give consent?
Members agree to the program terms when they enroll. Loyalty texts and emails are sent only to members who opted in.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: Who should use loyalty and memberships?
Cafés, retailers, salons and wellness studios with customers who visit again and again.

tree.style: border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; background: #fff;

tree: What happens if a reward is redeemed by mistake?
Staff with permission can reverse the redemption. Both the redemption and the reversal stay in the ledger.
